data_plane.routing: all endpoint peer, service, and Caldera traffic traverses the inline ndr-gateway

collection_plane.edr: each target writes generic process start/exit observations to an internal append-only spool; an independently stoppable forwarder writes label-free NormalizedEvent and SourceCoverage records to the sealed host evidence range
collection_plane.ndr: one inline Suricata EVE spool and independently stoppable strict normalizer/forwarder owned by ndr-gateway
collection_plane.health: process-authenticated forwarder status, parser validity, transport liveness, cursor, and observed lag for each of two EDR paths and one NDR path

execution_plane.card_executor: the host orchestrator executes frozen bash_no_profile templates at monotonic offsets after the evidence collector is ready
execution_plane.caldera_role: the pinned Caldera container preserves the isolated control-plane topology and release manifest; ENABLE_SANDCAT=false during formal primary-evidence windows, so Caldera identifiers and agent control traffic cannot enter the primary telemetry
execution_plane.optional_mirrors: Wazuh, guacamole-ai, and Aristaconnector-Control-Plane may consume a sealed copy only after primary bundle creation and are excluded from RT1-RT7 denominators

evaluation_plane.truth: offline Ground Truth Store containing Caldera/card/action receipts

health_contract.snapshot_digest_rule: RFC8785(SourceCoverage entries in UTF-8 source_instance order)

sensel_edge_conformance.gate: the lab NDR adapter and pinned sensor implementation must match canonical bytes, raw digest, event-id preimage result, source direction, and protected-IP admission on the same fixture

image_resolution: each image key must bind to an OCI SHA-256 digest, Dockerfile/build-context digest, installed-package manifest digest, and configuration digest before the first formal run

label_firewall.offline_only_values: all values and digest preimages from the sealed run/card/receipt manifests
label_firewall.enforcement: recursive key and exact-value rejection before NormalizedEvent construction; a match invalidates the run and halts formal collection
label_firewall.caldera_training_log: may be used only to verify action execution and construct offline labels; never as primary EDR evidence

fail_closed: a run missing any required field is retained in RT1 and the failure log but cannot enter RT2-RT7
formal_collection_gate: all required image and contract digests resolved
two EDR forwarder health paths and one NDR parser/forwarder health path pass a 30-minute soak
label-firewall regression passes on malicious and benign pilot runs
clock skew is within the frozen maximum
cleanup restores every target baseline digest
synthetic end-to-end runtime fixture produces schema-valid terminal outcomes
